name: basement-char-a
comment: Candidate A, THE HOOD: the basement bull as an iconic character (Colby, 2026-09-08 ~20:30: a designed character, approved before any video). Front first, five more angles from it.
subject: Live-action documentary realism, a full-body character study for a film: shot on a full-frame cinema camera with a 50 mm lens, soft even golden-hour light in a dense pine forest with the low sun flaring between the trunks behind, the figure centred and fully in frame head to toe, natural skin and fabric, fine film grain, true-to-life colour. No text, no logos, no real or recognisable person: a designed character. THE CHARACTER, CANDIDATE A: a lanky twenty-two-year-old in an oversized matte-black hoodie with the HOOD UP and cinched tight around his face, huge white over-ear headphones worn OVER the hood, oversized mirrored wraparound sunglasses hiding his eyes, a pale chin and a wispy chin-strap beard, baggy light-grey joggers, chunky white sneakers, a huge matte-black energy drink can with a plain green stripe (no logo, no words) and a phone with a cracked black case.
negative: text, letters, logos, brand names, watermark, cartoon, animation, illustration, CGI look, plastic skin, warped hands, extra limbs, celebrity likeness, explorer hat, moustache, cropped feet, cropped head
